name: session-panel
description: A side panel per session: blockers only the owner can clear in a red frame on top (put up by the model or, for a disconnected Chrome extension, by itself; taken down when the condition is seen gone), one row per task with its card status and pull request state, the links the replies carried, and one line per delivered result; only what recent replies carried shows, the rest folds behind one line; the owner ticks, edits, deletes and adds lines in place

cardsDir.title: Task cards folder
cardsDir.description: Absolute path of the folder with task cards named <TASK-ID>.md: the frontmatter status of every task the panel names shows on its row, and a done status closes the task.

doneStatuses.title: Done statuses
doneStatuses.description: Card frontmatter statuses that count as done.

taskPattern.title: Task id pattern
taskPattern.description: Regular expression a task id matches, searched in a link's address and label.

linkRoots.title: Link roots
linkRoots.description: Absolute (or ~/) folders, besides the session's folder, its repository, the cards folder and the vault, whose files a panel line may link to; a path outside every root stays plain text.

vault.title: Obsidian vault
vault.description: Absolute (or ~/) folder of the Obsidian vault: a .md file inside it links as obsidian://open with the folder's name as the vault; '' links every file to the editor.

waitMarker.title: Waiting block marker
waitMarker.description: The words that open a reply's block of what waits on the owner (`**Ждёт тебя:** …`, `### Ждёт тебя` and a list); its lines show at the top of the panel, replaced by the next reply that carries the block. '' turns the section off.
